articles.title: Majority Bit-Aware Watermarking For Large Language Models
articles.abstract: The growing deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has raised concerns about their misuse in generating harmful or deceptive content. To address this issue, watermarking methods have been proposed to embed identifiable multi-bit messages into generated text for misuse tracing. However, existing methods often suffer from a fundamental trade-off between text quality and decoding accuracy. In particular, they have to restrict the size of the preferred token set (i.e., green list) during encoding to maintain a detectable watermark signal for decoding, which inevitably degrades generation quality. To improve this trade-off, we propose a novel message encoding paradigm called \textit{majority bit-aware encoding}, which relaxes the watermark signal strength from the green list size. This strategy allows for a strong watermark signal to be preserved in generated texts even when using a large green list. We introduce two instantiations of this paradigm: MajorMark and MajorMark$^{+}$, where the latter is specifically optimized for long messages. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLMs demonstrate that our methods achieve higher decoding accuracy and superior text quality compared to prior baselines. The code is at https://github.com/JiiahaoXU/MajorMark.

articles.titleCn: 面向大型语言模型的大多数位感知水印技术
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的日益广泛部署引发了对其在生成有害或欺骗性内容方面被滥用的担忧。为解决这一问题，水印方法被提出，旨在将可识别的多比特信息嵌入生成文本中，以便追踪滥用行为。然而，现有方法往往在文本质量和解码精度之间存在一个基本权衡。具体而言，它们必须在编码过程中限制首选标记集（即绿色列表）的大小，以维持解码时可检测的水印信号，这不可避免地会降低生成质量。为改善这一权衡，我们提出了一种名为“多数比特感知编码”的新型信息编码范式，该范式放宽了水印信号强度与绿色列表大小之间的关系。这种策略允许在生成文本中保留强大的水印信号，即使使用较大的绿色列表也是如此。我们介绍了该范式的两种具体实现：MajorMark和MajorMark$^{+}$，后者特别针对长消息进行了优化。在当前最先进的LLMs上的大量实验表明，与先前基线相比，我们的方法实现了更高的解码精度和更优的文本质量。代码位于https://github.com/JiiahaoXU/MajorMark。

articles.title: Projection-Free Evolution Strategies for Continuous Prompt Search
articles.abstract: Continuous prompt search offers a computationally efficient alternative to conventional parameter tuning in natural language processing tasks. Nevertheless, its practical effectiveness can be significantly hindered by the black-box nature and the inherent high-dimensionality of the objective landscapes. Existing methods typically mitigate these challenges by restricting the search to a randomly projected low-dimensional subspace. However, the effectiveness and underlying motivation of the projection mechanism remain ambiguous. In this paper, we first empirically demonstrate that despite the prompt space possessing a low-dimensional structure, random projections fail to adequately capture this essential structure. Motivated by this finding, we propose a projection-free prompt search method based on evolutionary strategies. By directly optimizing in the full prompt space with an adaptation mechanism calibrated to the intrinsic dimension, our method achieves competitive search capabilities without additional computational overhead. Furthermore, to bridge the generalization gap in few-shot scenarios, we introduce a confidence-based regularization mechanism that systematically enhances the model's confidence in the target verbalizers. Experimental results on seven natural language understanding tasks from the GLUE benchmark demonstrate that our proposed approach significantly outperforms existing baselines.
articles.titleCn: 无投影进化策略用于连续提示搜索
articles.abstractCn: 连续提示搜索为自然语言处理任务中的传统参数调优提供了一种计算效率更高的替代方案。然而，其实际有效性可能因目标景观的黑盒性质和固有的高维性而受到显著阻碍。现有方法通常通过将搜索限制在随机投影的低维子空间中来缓解这些挑战。然而，投影机制的有效性和潜在动机仍然不明确。在本文中，我们首先通过实验证明，尽管提示空间具有低维结构，但随机投影无法充分捕捉这种关键结构。基于这一发现，我们提出了一种基于进化策略的无投影提示搜索方法。通过直接在完整提示空间中进行优化，并采用针对内在维度校准的适应机制，我们的方法在不增加额外计算开销的情况下实现了具有竞争力的搜索能力。此外，为了弥合少样本场景中的泛化差距，我们引入了一种基于置信度的正则化机制，该机制系统地增强了模型对目标语言化者的置信度。在GLUE基准测试的七个自然语言理解任务上的实验结果表明，我们提出的方法显著优于现有基线。

articles.title: ELF: Embedded Language Flows
articles.abstract: Diffusion and flow-based models have become the de facto approaches for generating continuous data, e.g., in domains such as images and videos. Their success has attracted growing interest in applying them to language modeling. Unlike their image-domain counterparts, today's leading diffusion language models (DLMs) primarily operate over discrete tokens. In this paper, we show that continuous DLMs can be made effective with minimal adaptation to the discrete domain. We propose Embedded Language Flows (ELF), a class of diffusion models in continuous embedding space based on continuous-time Flow Matching. Unlike existing DLMs, ELF predominantly stays within the continuous embedding space until the final time step, where it maps to discrete tokens using a shared-weight network. This formulation makes it straightforward to adapt established techniques from image-domain diffusion models, e.g., classifier-free guidance (CFG). Experiments show that ELF substantially outperforms leading discrete and continuous DLMs, achieving better generation quality with fewer sampling steps. These results suggest that ELF offers a promising path toward effective continuous DLMs.
articles.comment: NeurIPS 2026. arXiv v3: add GSM8k results
articles.abstractCn: 扩散模型和流模型已成为生成连续数据（例如图像和视频领域）的事实标准方法。它们的成功吸引了越来越多将它们应用于语言建模的兴趣。与图像领域的对应模型不同，当今领先的扩散语言模型（DLMs）主要在离散标记上运行。在本文中，我们表明，通过最小的离散域适配，连续DLMs可以变得有效。我们提出了嵌入式语言流（ELF），这是一种基于连续时间流匹配的连续嵌入空间中的扩散模型。与现有的DLMs不同，ELF主要在连续嵌入空间内运行，直到最后的时间步，才使用共享权重网络映射到离散标记。这种公式使得从图像域扩散模型中借鉴成熟技术（例如无分类器引导CFG）变得简单直接。实验表明，ELF在生成质量上显著优于领先的离散和连续DLMs，并且用更少的采样步骤实现了更好的效果。这些结果表明，ELF为有效连续DLMs提供了一条有前景的路径。

articles.title: Soft Token Alignment for Cross-Lingual Reasoning
articles.abstract: Multilingual large language models often produce inconsistent reasoning and answers for semantically equivalent prompts in different languages. Prior work suggests that intermediate representations can be relatively language-agnostic, but generation becomes increasingly language-specific as models commit to discrete output tokens. This is problematic because language-specific lexical choices can cause semantically equivalent reasoning paths to diverge across languages. These divergences motivate searching for a cross-lingual alignment signal that is less tied to any single vocabulary item or script. We propose SOLAR, an auxiliary objective for supervised fine-tuning that aligns soft-token representations across languages, using English as a pivot. Soft tokens are probability-weighted mixtures over the vocabulary embeddings, yielding continuous representations that can aggregate information from semantically related tokens across languages. We then align each non-English soft-token summary to its English counterpart in the shared embedding space. Across four multilingual reasoning benchmarks, SOLAR improves accuracy by up to +17.7 points over the base model and +3.8 over standard supervised fine-tuning, with the largest gains on low-resource languages. SOLAR also strengthens final-layer cross-lingual similarity and substantially reduces language-cluster separability, suggesting that aligning soft-token representations helps preserve shared semantic structure during multilingual reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 跨语言推理的软标记对齐
articles.abstractCn: 多语言大型语言模型在处理语义等价的不同语言提示时，往往会产生不一致的推理和答案。现有研究表明，中间表示可以相对独立于语言，但在模型确定离散输出标记时，生成过程会变得越来越特定于语言。这是一个问题，因为特定于语言的词汇选择会导致语义等价的推理路径在不同语言中产生分歧。这些分歧促使我们寻找一种跨语言对齐信号，这种信号与任何单个词汇项或书写系统都较少关联。我们提出了SOLAR，这是一种用于监督微调的辅助目标，它使用英语作为基准，对齐跨语言的软标记表示。软标记是词汇嵌入上的概率加权混合，产生连续表示，能够从跨语言的语义相关标记中聚合信息。然后，我们在共享嵌入空间中将每个非英语软标记总结与其英语对应物进行对齐。在四个多语言推理基准测试中，SOLAR使基础模型的准确率提高了高达+17.7分，比标准监督微调提高了+3.8分，在低资源语言上取得了最大提升。SOLAR还增强了最终层的跨语言相似性，并显著降低了语言簇的可分离性，表明对齐软标记表示有助于在多语言推理过程中保留共享的语义结构。

articles.title: TACG: Trajectory-Aware Commit Gating for Diffusion Language Model Decoding
articles.abstract: Diffusion language models predict many masked positions at each denoising step, but their efficiency and output quality depend on which predictions enter the evolving context. Confidence is informative but incomplete for this decision: at matched confidence, proposals with different identity and support histories exhibit different one-step revision rates. We propose Trajectory-Aware Commit Gating (TACG), a training-free decoder that separates the current token proposal from the decision to commit it. TACG scores temporal support for the current proposal by contrasting its logits with an exponential moving average of earlier logits, requires the proposal identity to persist through a History Gate, and promotes a capped number of additional positions per step. The gate decides which positions to commit and when; every written token remains the contemporaneous base proposal. On complete four-task LLaDA evaluations under the stated single-seed protocol, measured task-specific operating points reach 51.02\% mean accuracy with 67.82 mean model evaluations, compared with 48.00\% and 76.59 for Native Confidence. Under a matched per-event commit-count replay, history-guided selection exceeds confidence ranking by 8.3 accuracy points at identical per-sample NFE. History-reference interventions alter commitment timing while preserving the base-proposal write rule. Experiments on Dream and LLaDA2-Mini characterize quality--cost behavior across backbones and generation lengths. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Clarence-CV/TACG-DLLM.
articles.titleCn: TACG：针对扩散语言模型解码的轨迹感知提交门控
articles.abstractCn: 扩散语言模型在每次去噪步骤中预测多个掩码位置，但其效率和输出质量取决于哪些预测进入演变的上下文。置信度对于此决策具有信息量但不完整：在匹配的置信度下，具有不同身份和支持历史的提案表现出不同的单步修订率。我们提出了轨迹感知提交门控（TACG），一种无需训练的解码器，它将当前标记提案与提交该提案的决策分开。TACG通过将其logits与早期logits的指数移动平均值进行对比来评分当前提案的时间支持，要求提案身份通过历史门持续存在，并促进每步额外的位置数量上限。门控决定提交哪些位置以及何时提交；每个写入的标记仍然是当时的基准提案。在规定的单种子协议下，完整的四任务LLaDA评估中，测量的特定任务操作点达到51.02%的平均准确率，平均模型评估为67.82，而原生置信度为48.00%和76.59。在匹配的每事件提交计数重放下，历史引导选择在相同的每样本NFE下比置信度排序高8.3个准确点。历史参考干预改变提交时间，同时保留基准提案写入规则。Dream和LLaDA2-Mini上的实验描述了跨骨干和生成长度的质量-成本行为。代码公开可在https://github.com/Clarence-CV/TACG-DLLM。

articles.title: When Activation Oracles Learn Not to Read: Concept-Specific Blind Spots in Fine-Tuned Oracles
articles.abstract: Activation Oracles (AOs) are language models trained to answer natural-language questions about another model's internal activations. They offer a flexible interface for reading hidden information from model states, especially when relevant information is internally represented but absent or incomplete in visible behavior. However, AOs are themselves learned systems: their answers are shaped by training data, objectives, and learned reporting behavior, rather than being neutral readouts of represented information. We study this in a controlled Taboo Word Guessing setting, where subject models are fine-tuned to internally use a hidden concept while avoiding direct disclosure. Contrary to the expectation that an AO trained on such a subject becomes a specialist reader, we find that fine-tuned AOs can become concept-specific anti-readers: they selectively fail to recover the concept persistently present during their own training. This failure is not simply explained by absence of the concept from the subject or oracle representations: the target remains decodable inside the oracle, while LogitLens and layer-ablation analyses indicate that the failure arises in the AO readout pathway. Our results show that behavioral leakage, representation-level decodability, and AO-verbalizability can come apart, raising a reliability concern for learned interpretability interfaces.

articles.titleCn: 当激活预言机不再阅读：微调预言机中的特定概念盲点
articles.abstractCn: 激活预言机（AOs）是训练用来回答关于另一个模型内部激活的自然语言问题的语言模型。它们为从模型状态中读取隐藏信息提供了灵活的接口，尤其是在相关信息在内部表示但可见行为中缺失或不完备时。然而，AOs本身也是学习系统：它们的答案受到训练数据、目标和学习到的报告行为的影响，而不是对所表示信息的客观读取。我们在一个受控的禁忌词猜测环境中研究这一问题，其中被试模型被微调以在内部使用一个隐藏概念，同时避免直接披露。与预期中在这样一个被试上训练的AO会成为一个专业读取者的观点相反，我们发现微调的AO可以成为特定概念的反读取器：它们会选择性地持续无法恢复其训练期间持续存在的概念。这种失败不能简单地用被试或预言机表示中概念的缺失来解释：目标仍然可以在预言机内部被解码，而LogitLens和层消融分析表明，这种失败发生在AO读取路径中。我们的结果表明，行为泄露、表示级可解码性和AO可言语化可以分离，这对学习型可解释性接口的可靠性提出了担忧。

articles.title: Twig: Parallel and Memory-Efficient Tree Speculative Decoding for Hybrid-Attention LLMs
articles.abstract: Emerging LLMs increasingly interleave full attention with recurrent linear attention to reduce long-context serving costs. Tree speculative decoding could further accelerate these hybrid models, but recurrent linear-attention layers carry parent-dependent states. Existing engines therefore verify proposal trees sequentially and snapshot the full state per node, causing latency and memory to grow with tree and batch sizes. We present Twig, a kernel--runtime co-design for tree speculative decoding of hybrid LLMs. Twig derives a tree-structured factorization of the linear-attention recurrence and realizes it with a resource-efficient GPU kernel that verifies all nodes in parallel, accelerating linear-attention tree verification by 3.4--7.7$\times$. It losslessly represents speculative state updates as token-level factors and reconstructs only the accepted state, reducing transient state memory by 82--99$\times$ and freeing GPU memory for KV caches. We integrate Twig into SGLang, a widely deployed production LLM serving engine, and further optimize its runtime through batch-wide verification budgeting. Across four models, two GPU platforms, and diverse datasets, Twig achieves up to $4.72\times$ the offline decode throughput of autoregressive decoding and up to $2.03\times$ that of the strongest tree-speculative baseline. Under online agent workloads, Twig reduces TTFT and TPOT by up to $67.6\%$ and $49.9\%$, respectively, over the strongest tree-speculative baseline.
articles.titleCn: Twig：面向混合注意力大语言模型的并行与内存高效树形推测解码
articles.abstractCn: 新兴的大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地将全注意力机制与循环线性注意力机制相结合，以降低长上下文服务的成本。树形推测解码可以进一步加速这些混合模型，但循环线性注意力层携带父依赖状态。因此，现有引擎按顺序验证提议树，并对每个节点快照完整状态，导致延迟和内存随树和批处理规模的增长而增加。我们提出了Twig，这是一种针对混合LLM树形推测解码的核-运行时协同设计。Twig推导出线性注意力递归的树形结构分解，并使用资源高效的GPU核并行验证所有节点，将线性注意力树验证加速3.4--7.7倍。它无损地表示推测状态更新为token级因子，并仅重建接受状态，将瞬态状态内存减少82--99倍，并释放GPU内存用于KV缓存。我们将Twig集成到SGLang中，这是一种广泛部署的生产LLM服务引擎，并通过全局批处理验证预算进一步优化其运行时。在四个模型、两种GPU平台和多样化数据集上，Twig实现了自回归解码离线解码吞吐量的4.72倍，以及最强树形推测基线的2.03倍。在在线代理工作负载下，与最强树形推测基线相比，Twig将TTFT和TPOT分别降低了高达67.6%和49.9%。

articles.title: Undertone: Personalizing Frozen VLM Aesthetic Judges from Few Ratings
articles.abstract: Image quality assessment predicts a mean opinion score (MOS), but for image aesthetics the mean hides the individual, so personalized assessment must start from the few images a new user rates. Fitting each person from scratch fails with ten ratings; networks fine-tuned per person carry over poorly to new kinds of images. We present Undertone-P, which learns from other raters a Gaussian prior over per-person regression weights on read-outs of frozen vision-language model (VLM) judges: the probability-weighted rating and the hidden state at the score token. Since people differ from the crowd in ways other raters reveal, a few ratings need only choose among those ways: a new user costs one closed-form solve, and no network is trained. On Ryu and Yanaka's PARA benchmark, the prior alone reaches a Spearman correlation of .640, above the best published 10- and 100-rating results (.581 and .620); 10 and 100 of a person's ratings raise it to .648 and .676. These ratings add most where tastes depart from the crowd: with 100 ratings, +.067 for the raters who agree least with it and +.206 on LAPIS artworks, against +.037 overall. Without labels, the judges' expected scores predict PARA's MOS at .835 (best published model we ran: .694). PARA-trained networks still lead under PARA's original protocol, likely through a stronger end-to-end MOS model.
articles.comment: v2: substantially revised and retitled; supersedes v1 ("Feed the Panel Dimensions, Not Verdicts: Rubric-Decomposed Fusion of Vision-Language Aesthetic Judges"). 4 pages + references, 2 figures, 2 tables
articles.titleCn: 基调：基于少量评分个性化定制Frozen VLM美学裁判
articles.abstractCn: 图像质量评估预测平均意见得分（MOS），但对于图像美学而言，平均值掩盖了个体差异，因此个性化评估必须从新用户评价的少量图像开始。从头为每个人拟合模型在评价十个图像时就会失败；针对每个人微调的网络难以泛化到新的图像类型。我们提出了Undertone-P，它从其他评价者那里学习关于冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）裁判读数上个人回归权重的高斯先验：概率加权评分和得分标记处的隐藏状态。由于人们在其他评价者揭示的方面与群体不同，少量评价只需要在这些方面中进行选择：新用户只需一次封闭形式求解，无需训练网络。在Ryu和Yanaka的PARA基准上，先验本身达到了Spearman相关系数0.640，高于已发表的10次和100次评价结果（0.581和0.620）；个人的10次和100次评价将其提升至0.648和0.676。这些评价在品味与群体差异最大的地方贡献最大：在100次评价中，与它最不认同的评价者的评分提升了+0.067，对LAPIS艺术品的评分提升了+0.206，而整体提升了+0.037。没有标签时，裁判的预期评分预测PARA的MOS为0.835（我们运行的最好已发表模型：0.694）。经过PARA训练的网络在PARA原始协议下仍然领先，这可能是由于更强的端到端MOS模型。

articles.title: P2N: Reusing Deep Representations for Greater Effective Depth
articles.abstract: Mathematical problem solving and autonomous agents are increasingly important applications of language models, demanding stronger reasoning capabilities. Computational depth is a key resource for such reasoning, but adding model layers increases both training and inference costs, while test-time scaling incurs substantial additional inference computation. We introduce P2N (Previous to Next), which reuses the previous token's deep representations, already available during generation, to increase effective computational depth with negligible decoding overhead. Specifically, P2N adds the previous token's deep hidden state to the current token's shallow representation, allowing subsequent layers to build on previously completed deep computation. This recurrence extends effective computational depth across tokens, while introducing only a single vector addition per decoding step. We train the recurrence using parallel Jacobi updates restricted to a middle-layer core. Experiments with Qwen-style models show that, at 1.5B parameters, P2N improves GSM8K accuracy by over 10 percentage points under both zero-shot and few-shot prompting, with nearly unchanged decoding latency. The benefits also extend to language modeling and average performance on general downstream benchmarks. on general downstream benchmarks.
articles.titleCn: P2N：重用深度表示以实现更有效的深度
articles.abstractCn: 数学问题解决和自主智能体是语言模型日益重要的应用，需要更强的推理能力。计算深度是这种推理的关键资源，但增加模型层数会提高训练和推理成本，而测试时扩展则会产生大量额外的推理计算。我们引入P2N（Previous to Next），它重用生成过程中已可用的先前标记的深度表示，以在可忽略的解码开销下增加有效计算深度。具体而言，P2N将先前标记的深度隐藏状态添加到当前标记的浅层表示中，使后续层能够基于先前完成的深度计算进行构建。这种递归扩展了跨标记的有效计算深度，而每步解码仅需引入一个向量加法。我们使用仅限于中间层核心的并行雅可比更新来训练这种递归。在Qwen风格模型上的实验表明，在15亿参数规模下，P2N在零样本和少样本提示下将GSM8K准确率提高了10个百分点以上，解码延迟几乎未变。这些优势也扩展到了语言建模和一般下游基准测试的平均性能。

articles.title: AutoVend: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Vending Operations
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are extending agent-mediated commerce on the Web from shopping for consumers to operating businesses for sellers. In online-to-offline (O2O) commerce, decisions are issued through Web-based platforms but realized through costly physical execution. Evaluating such agents requires going beyond individual transactions to ask whether decisions made online turn into sustained economic returns. We introduce AutoVend, a benchmark in which one LLM agent manages 20 vending machines across five site types through a Web-based operating interface for 180 simulated days. Its data-grounded simulator combines a shared warehouse, procurement lead times, paid replenishment, inventory expiration, and recurring operating costs. We evaluate five LLM agents against a rule-based inventory-control baseline and diagnose their site coordination, execution, and performance over time. Four of five evaluated LLM agents fall short of this baseline, and returns per dollar of inference cost rank models differently from returns alone. Operational analyses show that gains in individual metrics do not consistently yield stronger economic growth, as inventory and execution costs erode these gains. Trajectory analysis further reveals difficulties in grounding feasible actions, managing inventory commitments, and converting feedback into effective policy revisions.
articles.titleCn: AutoVend：在长时程自主售货操作中对大型语言模型代理进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理正在将基于代理的电子商务从为消费者购物扩展到为卖家经营业务。在线上线下（O2O）电子商务中，决策通过基于网络的平台发布，但通过昂贵的物理执行来实现。评估此类代理需要超越单个交易，询问在线做出的决策是否转化为持续的经济回报。我们介绍了AutoVend，这是一个基准，其中一个LLM代理通过基于网络的操作系统在180个模拟日内管理分布在五种不同类型站点上的20台自动售货机。其数据驱动的模拟器结合了共享仓库、采购提前期、付费补货、库存过期和重复运营成本。我们评估了五个LLM代理，并与基于规则的库存控制基线进行了比较，诊断了它们在时间推移中的站点协调、执行和性能。五个被评估的LLM代理中有四个未能达到该基线，每美元推理成本的回报与单独的回报排名不同。运营分析表明，单个指标的提升并不始终带来更强的经济增长，因为库存和执行成本侵蚀了这些收益。轨迹分析进一步揭示了在将可行行动基础化、管理库存承诺以及将反馈转化为有效政策修订方面存在的困难。

articles.title: HyFlash: A Prefix-Memory Prior for On-Device Speculative Decoding
articles.abstract: Parallel block drafting accelerates speculative decoding by predicting multiple future positions in a single backbone pass, but on-device deployment constrains both drafter capacity and context storage. Under tight memory budgets, drafters must model long-range dependencies and fine-grained draft-position interactions without the growing KV-cache overhead of full-context attention. We propose HyFlash, a compact parallel drafter that introduces a prefix-memory prior to separate long-range context modeling from fine-grained draft-position interactions with limited capacity. Local attention captures recent context and draft-position interactions, while recurrent memory compresses historical target features into fixed-size states. This inductive bias enables effective local and long-range modeling with bounded draft-side memory. Experiments show that HyFlash achieves higher acceptance than full-context attention with substantially less KV storage and with larger gains for shallow drafters and long contexts.
articles.titleCn: HyFlash：一种设备上推测解码的前缀记忆先验
articles.abstractCn: 并行块生成通过在单个骨干网络遍历中预测多个未来位置来加速推测解码，但在设备上部署时，生成器容量和上下文存储都受到限制。在紧张的内存预算下，生成器必须在没有全上下文注意力不断增长的KV缓存开销的情况下，对长距离依赖关系和细粒度生成位置交互进行建模。我们提出了HyFlash，这是一种紧凑的并行生成器，它引入了一个前缀内存，将长距离上下文建模与细粒度生成位置交互分离开来，并具有有限的容量。局部注意力捕获最近的上下文和生成位置交互，而循环内存将历史目标特征压缩成固定大小的状态。这种归纳偏差使得在有限的生成端内存边界内进行有效的局部和长距离建模成为可能。实验表明，HyFlash比全上下文注意力具有更高的接受度，同时KV存储量显著减少，并且对浅层生成器和长上下文来说收益更大。

articles.title: Encoding and Propagation of Grammatical Number in Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become an increasingly popular means of translating Large Language Model (LLM) hidden state vectors into a human-comprehensible list of features or symbols. As such, SAEs may provide insight into an LLM's knowledge representation and internal ``mental'' grammar - topics of pragmatic interest for mechanistic interpretation of AI behavior and of theoretical interest for the study of in silico representations of human language. Language models with fewer than 100M parameters, trained on small corpora, nonetheless exhibit strong grammatical competence and discourse coherence, despite producing content of limited reliability. We use SAEs that we trained on one such model (Pythia-70M) to conduct an in-depth examination of how a single grammatical phenomenon, number agreement, is represented and processed in an LLM. We demonstrate the mechanism and the methodology by which SAEs can be used to find and propagate ``plural noun'', ``plural matrix subject'', and ``generate a plural verb'' features which cause the LLM to produce plural verb forms such as ``are'', ``do'', or ``have'' instead of ``is'', ``does'', and ``has'' in response to prompts such as ``the men in the park''. We show that intervening to remove these features from the hidden states of plural subject noun tokens causes the model to produce singular verbs instead, and vice versa. We also show that corresponding ``singular noun'' and ``generate a singular verb'' features are not as effective for this task. This asymmetry suggests that Pythia-70m makes use of a privative representation of grammatical number in English. These findings replicated with larger LLMs Gemma-2-2b and Llama-3.1-8b yielded similar results. Our main contribution is a novel approach to the use of SAEs to understanding how LLMs encode human language that addresses a number of technical and methodological challenges.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型中语法数的编码与传播
articles.abstractCn: 稀疏自动编码器（SAEs）已成为将大型语言模型（LLM）的隐藏状态向量转化为人类可理解的特征或符号列表的一种日益流行的手段。因此，SAEs可能为理解LLM的知识表示和内部“心理”语法提供洞察，这些主题对于人工智能行为的机制解释具有实际意义，对于人类语言计算机模拟表示的研究具有理论意义。参数少于1亿、在小型语料库上训练的语言模型，尽管生成的内容可靠性有限，但仍然表现出强大的语法能力和话语连贯性。我们使用在其中一个模型（Pythia-70M）上训练的SAEs，对单一语法现象——数的一致性——在LLM中的表示和处理方式进行了深入考察。我们展示了SAEs如何通过机制和方法找到并传播“复数名词”、“复数矩阵主语”和“生成复数动词”等特征，这些特征导致LLM在响应诸如“公园里的男人”等提示时生成复数动词形式（如“are”、“do”或“have”），而不是“is”、“does”和“has”。我们表明，干预以从复数主语名词的隐藏状态中移除这些特征，会导致模型生成单数动词，反之亦然。我们还表明，相应的“单数名词”和“生成单数动词”特征对此任务的效果并不那么显著。这种不对称性表明，Pythia-70M在英语中使用了语法数的否定表示。这些发现在与更大的LLM Gemma-2-2b和Llama-3.1-8b的实验中得到了验证，并产生了相似的结果。我们的主要贡献是一种新颖的方法，用于利用SAEs来理解LLM如何编码人类语言，该方法解决了许多技术和方法论上的挑战。

articles.title: EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments
articles.abstract: An LLM agent's cost and success depend on its model, its harness, and its environment. In addition to the widely studied directions of parameter tuning and harness optimization, we propose the third direction: optimization over stationary environments. Agents are often deployed in rich environments shared by many tasks, such as a company's Slack workspace or a complex collection of data sources, documents or tickets. We call these environments stationary environments. We introduce EnvOpt, a method for automated end-to-end optimization of stationary environments for any given model and harness, using real or synthetic tasks without needing any graders or reference answers. On AutomationBench, EnvOpt reduces the cost of Claude Haiku 4.5 by 72.7% and raises its pass rate by 14.34%. The same environment transfers to Opus 5, cutting its cost by 68.1% with a 1.34% gain. Added on top of Meta-Harness's optimized harness for Haiku 4.5, it lowers cost by a further 83.4% and adds 11.17% accuracy over Meta-Harness alone. Across 5 benchmarks, EnvOpt significantly reduces the cost of agents while improving or maintaining pass rate, and is transferable to different models and different harnesses. We also discuss common successful and rejected environment optimization strategies during automated optimization. More broadly, our results show that how information is represented to an agent shapes both its cost and its success, making the environment worth optimizing in addition to the parameters and the harness.
articles.titleCn: EnvOpt：智能体环境的自动化优化
articles.abstractCn: 一个大型语言模型代理的成本和成功率取决于其模型、其适配器和其环境。除了广泛研究的参数调整和适配器优化方向外，我们提出了第三个方向：对稳态环境的优化。代理通常部署在由许多任务共享的丰富环境中，例如公司的Slack工作区或复杂的数据源、文档或工单集合。我们将这些环境称为稳态环境。我们介绍了EnvOpt，这是一种用于对任何给定模型和适配器进行稳态环境的自动端到端优化的方法，使用真实或合成任务，无需任何评分器或参考答案。在AutomationBench上，EnvOpt将Claude Haiku 4.5的成本降低了72.7%，将其通过率提高了14.34%。相同的稳态环境迁移到Opus 5，成本降低了68.1%，通过率提高了1.34%。在Meta-Harness对Haiku 4.5优化的适配器基础上，它进一步降低了83.4%的成本，并比Meta-Harness单独优化增加了11.17%的准确率。在5个基准测试中，EnvOpt显著降低了代理的成本，同时提高了或维持了通过率，并且可以迁移到不同的模型和不同的适配器。我们还讨论了在自动优化过程中常见的成功和被拒绝的环境优化策略。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，向代理呈现信息的方式会同时影响其成本和成功率，使得环境除了参数和适配器之外也值得优化。

articles.title: Latency-Aware Adaptive Best-of-$N$
articles.abstract: Test-time compute (TTC) improves language model responses by spending additional computation at inference time, and the right amount of compute depends on the prompt. Adaptive TTC methods allocate compute based on signals of response quality such as observed rewards, often by stopping once the signal exceeds a fixed threshold, and generally measure cost by the number of generations or tokens. But in online serving, latency is also a cost: it grows with server load, so a method using a fixed threshold spends too little compute when generation is fast and too much when it is slow. For Best-of-$N$ sampling, a widely used TTC method, we propose a two-stage adaptive algorithm that draws an initial batch, then uses the observed rewards and the batch's latency to decide whether to draw a second batch and at what size by comparing expected improvement against predicted cost: it draws one when the first batch's best reward is below a threshold that decreases with the first batch's latency, without explicitly measuring server load. We map each reward to its value under the cumulative distribution function (CDF) of the prompt's reward distribution, so the same tradeoff parameters can be reused across tasks; a regression fitted offline on other prompts predicts a distribution for the CDF value of the first batch's best reward, giving the expected improvement in closed form. We evaluate the method by simulation on a preference-based alignment benchmark, measuring generations-equivalent cost: generations plus latency, converted to generations. The method reaches Best-of-$N$'s reward at lower generations-equivalent cost, and conditioning on the measured first-batch latency saves at least as much of that cost as fixed-threshold (latency-unaware) baselines, and more when latency is highly variable, when it grows with batch size, and when the second batch's latency is highly predictable from the first's.
articles.abstractCn: 测试时计算（TTC）通过在推理时增加额外计算来提升语言模型的响应质量，而合适的计算量取决于提示内容。自适应TTC方法根据响应质量信号（如观察到的奖励）分配计算量，通常通过在信号超过固定阈值时停止计算来实现，并且通常以生成次数或token数量来衡量成本。但在在线服务中，延迟也是一种成本：它随服务器负载增加而增长，因此使用固定阈值的方法在生成速度快时计算量不足，在生成慢时计算量过多。对于广泛使用的TTC方法Best-of-$N$采样，我们提出了一种两阶段自适应算法：先抽取一个初始批次，然后根据观察到的奖励和批次的延迟来决定是否抽取第二个批次及其大小，通过比较预期改进与预测成本来决定：当第一个批次的最佳奖励低于一个随第一个批次延迟下降的阈值时，抽取一个批次，而无需显式测量服务器负载。我们将每个奖励映射到提示奖励分布的累积分布函数（CDF）下的值，因此相同的权衡参数可以在不同任务中复用；离线拟合其他提示的回归模型预测第一个批次的最佳奖励的CDF值分布，从而以封闭形式给出预期改进。我们在基于偏好的对齐基准上通过模拟评估该方法，衡量生成等价成本：生成次数加上延迟，并转换为生成次数。该方法以更低的生成等价成本达到Best-of-$N$的奖励，并且根据测量的第一个批次延迟的条件至少节省了与固定阈值（无延迟感知）基线相同的成本，在延迟高度可变、延迟随批次大小增长以及第二个批次的延迟高度可从第一个批次预测时，节省更多。
